assumptions: 'Success rate' means attempt-level success rate: successful attempts divided by all attempts, with each retry counted as a separate attempt. Order-level and technical rates are shown alongside.
Success rate definition assumed: attempt success rate.
The comparison covers UPI and card (by method family) within 1 to 31 August 2026.
caveats: Missing issuer IDs on Meridian Bank card attempts (8.0% in August 2026) understate issuer-level results for that scope. The rows were kept and shown as '(missing)' issuer, not corrected. The overall UPI and card rates above do not depend on issuer ID.
This is a single-month comparison with no second period, so it says nothing about whether the gap is widening or narrowing.

facts.text: UPI attempt success rate in August 2026 was 93.1% (184,077 successful of 197,696 attempts; 95% interval 93.0% to 93.2%).
Card attempt success rate in August 2026 was 86.6% (109,912 successful of 126,939 attempts; 95% interval 86.4% to 86.8%).

UPI's success rate was 6.52pp higher than card's. The two confidence intervals do not overlap, and the two-proportion test marks the gap as statistically significant (z = 62.04) and practically significant.
The data-quality scan found one warning: 8.0% of Meridian Bank's card attempts in August 2026 (2,856 of 35,507) have no issuer ID, against an expected 0%.

response.headline: UPI succeeded more often than card in August 2026: 93.1% versus 86.6%, a gap of 6.52pp that is statistically and practically significant.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Break card and UPI failures down by failure code per 100 attempts, and by issuer and acquirer, to see which failure types drive the gap.
hypotheses.rationale: The evidence shows only the size of the gap, not why it exists. This is a common structural explanation for card versus UPI differences but is not tested here.
hypotheses.text: Part of the gap may come from card payments having more steps that can fail (issuer authentication such as 3-D Secure/OTP, issuer declines) than UPI's more direct bank-to-bank flow.

recommendations.linked_fact_or_hypothesis: The gap between UPI and card is 6.52pp and statistically and practically significant.
recommendations.rationale: The gap is large and significant, so locating its source is the quickest path to a fix.
recommendations.text: Break down card failures by failure code, issuer and acquirer for August to find where the 6.52pp gap is concentrated.

recommendations.linked_fact_or_hypothesis: 8.0% of Meridian Bank card attempts in August 2026 have no issuer ID.
recommendations.rationale: Missing issuer IDs make issuer-level results for this scope unreliable.
recommendations.text: Ask the data team to fix the missing issuer IDs on Meridian Bank card attempts before running any issuer-level comparison.
